prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game classroom BACKGROUND LAYER ONLY, wide 16:9 2048x1152 composition. Create a lavish, warm, polished hand-painted Russian language classroom/study interior with textured honey walnut wood, warm gold highlights, atmospheric afternoon sunlight, painterly storybook semi-realism. Camera front-on, eye level, perspective restrained to frame the future UI. Tall mullioned window at far left shows a softly painted blue sky and distant colorful Russian onion domes. Left foreground: brass lamp with an amber fabric shade, white blossoms in a cobalt and cream porcelain vase, two painted wooden nesting dolls and stacked burgundy and navy leather books. Rich tall bookcases across upper background and along right quarter, varied leather bindings with gold decorative lines but ABSOLUTELY NO letters or text. Bottom 12 percent: richly textured wooden desk, blank open exercise book slightly left of center, black and gold fountain pen, blue-white porcelain cup of steaming tea on saucer near lower right, a few biscuits and red embroidered cloth. Important functional composition: central region x=20%-78%, y=14%-84% must be a quiet evenly lit low-contrast warm wood/bookcase backdrop because a separate large opaque menu or blackboard asset will cover this region. Rightmost x=79%-100%, y=30%-76% is an EMPTY character stage in front of bookshelves, leave room for a separate teacher portrait. No people, no teacher, no blackboard, no central menu board, no interface, no buttons, no numbers, no words, no labels, no watermarks. This is an original environment layer, NOT a finished game screenshot. Text and all UI will be separate interactive engine controls. Strong fine material detail and rich warm depth; avoid flat vector shapes.
prompts.parchment: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent game UI menu FRAME with completely blank parchment interior, NOT a screenshot. Create one gorgeous frontal flat hand-painted wooden and parchment panel, overall width:height about 1.3:1 (near 1100x850), isolated on a REAL transparent background. Rich honey walnut carved wooden outer frame with golden beveled highlights, softly rounded clipped corners, restrained old Russian botanical ornament. At top center an integrated small cream-and-gold wooden crest with a dark brown simple ornamental skyline of onion domes (decorative symbol only, not letters). Broad pale ivory parchment interior with subtle warm paper grain and softly aged edges, NOT burnt. Blank cream center covers at least 85% width and 80% height, very light, even, excellent for dark dynamic UI text. Two small elegant rowan berry and olive leaf sprays painted in upper inner corners, fine gold flourish at bottom corners, delicate carved wood rails; ornaments confined to margins so there is large unobstructed writing space. Straight-on front view, no perspective, complete frame visible with a little transparent margin all around, soft small natural drop shadow, professional polished painterly adventure-game texture. Do NOT include any words, letters, numbers, buttons, icons in the center, cards, menus, mockup UI, characters, classroom, desktop or background scene. All UI text, controls and selection cards will be separate interactive engine nodes. Do not create multiple panels or an asset sheet. No checkerboard pattern, no white opaque background. Color and material should match a luxurious warm wood Russian classroom, golden amber outline and light cream paper.
prompts.blackboard: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. The supplied image is an existing user-provided EMPTY BLACKBOARD runtime asset, not a whole game screenshot. Produce a clean independent transparent blackboard asset suitable for the same game. Preserve the original dark textured green writing surface, amber carved wooden frame, cream-gold ornamental crest with onion-dome skyline at top center, tiny rowan leaves at upper inner corners, faint chalk architecture drawing lower left, chalk and eraser on the bottom rail. Improve ONLY the contaminated outside silhouette/alpha and framing: remove ALL yellow, pink, red, black and white stray fragments/pixels outside the wood and crest; use clean true transparent background with smooth antialiased edges. Include the COMPLETE crest and complete frame, uncropped, with a small transparent margin all around. Frame front-on, horizontal aspect about 1.7:1 including crest. Interior must remain completely BLANK with no words, no questions, no buttons, no options, no numerals. Keep original material richness and calm low-contrast usable green writing center. Do not add characters or a classroom background. Do not include checkerboard or opaque backdrop. Single isolated image only. Maintain hand-painted soft storybook material style and original decorative theme.
